newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle steady-up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle steady-up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers under 700 pounds were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, weights over 700 pounds were not fully tested, compared to last week, USDA said.

Bulk supply Medium and Large 1-2 350-700 lb feeder steers and heifers. Trade moderate. Demand moderate. Feeder steers and heifers under 600 lbs 50 percent, over 600 lbs 28 percent with cows and bulls around 22 percent of total supply. Receipts - 1,065 Week Ago - 2,018 Year Ago - 1,100
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 79.50-85.75; few 700-775 lbs 76.50- 77.50; lot 900 lbs 68.75. Medium and Large 1-2 - lot 560 lbs 82.00; 600-700 lbs 76.50-79.50.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 500-600 lbs 79.00-80.75, lot 500 lbs 82.00; 600-700 lbs 75.00- 78.75. Medium and Large 1-2 - two small lots 580-595 lbs 77.00; 675-725 lbs 71.50-74.75.
